title: H. A. Nicolsky, Candidate For Employment As Driver Of Reserve Unit

page_data.en:
S.C
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. RLGIST
D. D. 7771
Section 1, Special Branch/37
REPORT
Date February 14th 39.
Subject: N. A. Nicolsky, candidate for employment as Driver of Reserve Unit.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by Iboyu D.S.I

Herman Alexandrovitch NICOLSKY, Russian, was born on
June 11, 1910 at Blagoveschensk, Amur Province. According
to his own statement he fled from Vladivostock to Manchuria
in 1924 together with his cousin and subsequently resided in
Harbin where he attended a commercial school for about four
years. Soon upon leaving the school he proceeded to Shanghai
in quest of employment, arriving in this city in the end of
September, 1928. On January 11, 1929 he joined the
Russian Detachment, S.V.C. From 1.9.32 he has been attach-
ed to the Transport Office, S.V.C. Headquarters.
On 6.12.35 he married Miss Rogneda S. Gantimurova. His
elder sister is the wife of Mr. A. G. Kuropatov, an employee
of the Chinese Maritime Customs, who at present is in Swatow.
He states that apart from his sister he has no relatives in
China.
Nicolsky is registered with the Russian Emigrants'
Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road on the strength of an emigrants
passport issued at Harbin. In the Committee's register the
date of his birth is stated as 16.6.1907. In this connection
Nicolsky explained that he had given a false declaration to the
Harbin Police regarding his age in order to obtain a separate
passport.
Discreet enquiries among members of the Russian Detachment
reveal that he is regarded with suspicion by some of them on
account of his antecedents. It appears that the suspicion is
based solely on a rumour that while in Harbin he was employed
for some time as a chauffeur with the Far Eastern Bank, a Soviet
institution. However, no confirmation of this rumour could be
obtained.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 RLGIST
D. D. 7771
第1科，特别支部/37
报告
日期：1939年2月14日。
事由：N. A. Nicolsky，后备队司机职位候选人。
由特别调查员 Prokofiev 撰写，经特别调查员 Iboyu 转呈

赫尔曼·亚历山德罗维奇·尼科尔斯基（Herman Alexandrovitch NICOLSKY），俄国人，1910年6月11日出生于阿穆尔省布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveschensk）。据其自述，他于1924年与其表亲一同从符拉迪沃斯托克逃往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨，并在那里的一所商业学校就读约四年。离校后不久，他便前往上海求职，于1928年9月底抵达本市。1929年1月11日，他加入上海义勇队（S.V.C.）俄国分队。自1932年9月1日起，他隶属于上海义勇队总部运输处。
1935年12月6日，他与罗格涅达·S·甘蒂穆罗娃小姐（Miss Rogneda S. Gantimurova）结婚。他的姐姐是 A. G. 库罗帕托夫先生（Mr. A. G. Kuropatov）的妻子，库罗帕托夫是中国海关职员，目前位于汕头。他表示，除了姐姐外，他在中国没有其他亲属。
尼科尔斯基凭在哈尔滨签发的难民护照，在莫尔缅路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记。在该委员会的登记册中，他的出生日期记载为1907年6月16日。就此，尼科尔斯基解释说，为了获得单独护照，他曾向哈尔滨警方虚报年龄。
对俄国分队成员的谨慎查询显示，由于他的过往经历，部分队员对他持怀疑态度。这种怀疑似乎仅基于一种传言，即他在哈尔滨期间曾受雇于远东银行（一家苏维埃机构）担任司机一段时间。然而，未能获得证实该传言的证据。

Nicolasky has a clean record with the Russian Detachment
and while in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of the
Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an
undesirable nature.
